Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with 18 geometric neighbors (9 Pt, 9 Zn), Pt centers with 9 Zn neighbors, and Zn centers with 10 neighbors (4 Ce, 6 Zn). Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Zn 10-vertex polyhedra and between Ce 18-vertex and Zn 10-vertex polyhedra.
